difficulty_reason: The forgetful functor from dg modules to graded modules has an exact left adjoint: existence via the adjoint functor theorem (roles of F and G swapped) with the exactness clauses from lemma-dgm-abelian, and the solution-set condition proved by hand - for a map from a graded module N into F(M) the author takes the differential graded submodule generated by the image and writes the explicit map (n, sum n_i tensor a_i) |-> phi(n) + sum d(phi(n_i)) a_i, bounding the isomorphism classes. Retained author proof at lines 3522-3552.
